exposure: nuchal thickness (diameter of hygroma) of >=5 mm
cohort: The study included 107 fetuses with cystic hygroma managed in the institute between January 2006 and June 2019.
finding: Of 26 livebirths from fetuses with ameliorated cystic hygroma, half had a good outcome while the other half had various abnormalities, and a nuchal thickness of >=5 mm was significantly correlated with these abnormalities.
